author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Vicar
with sinister
whiskers
is picker of
pictures
spinster
of scriptures

quicker
meaning sifter
than cheap
liquor

Call em
Fixer
Shape shifter
situated inverter
poetic grifter
prophetic lifter a
sifter of aesthetic
blisters
in verse
